To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) CNN based action recognition is a hot research topic and has been applied to many real-world applications; 2) CNN based action recognizers are mainly divided into two categories: 3D CNN based and non 3D CNN (or 2D CNN) based, and the latter is further divided into three strategies: taking motion related information as input, fusion, and others.

1) CNN based action recognition has been greatly improved by exploiting temporal information, which can be achieved by three strategies; 2) 3D convolutional kernel has the best performance, while the fusion strategy is the easiest way to incorporate temporal information.
the performance of the CNN based video recognition is greatly improved by the following strategies: 3D CNN, motion related information as input, and fusion.

a comprehensive review of CNN based video action recognition methods.
the development of new techniques for video action recognition.
the following issues: 1) What is the current state-of-the-art of CNN-based action recognition? 2) How do CNNs perform on the large scale action recognition datasets?

the 3D CNN based method is a promising way to exploit temporal information.
the CNN based action recognitions can achieve the state-of-the-art results.

the CNN based action recognizers are still far from satisfactory and the performance of CNN based action recognitions are still inferior to the hand-crafted features based action recognitions.
